title: Black Eyes
desc_lfm_artist:
Black Eyes are an American post-hardcore band from Washington, D.C. that initially existed from August 2001 to March 2004, disbanding two months prior to the release of its second album, Cough. The group reformed in 2022. Its members included Dan Caldas, Jacob Long, Mike Kanin, Daniel Martin-McCormick and Hugh McElroy.

desc_lfm_artist: Racebannon is a genre-defying avant-garde hardcore punk band from Indianapolis which formed in 1996. Begun as a screamo band on Witching Hour Records, the band has constantly evolved its sound over the last 15 years. Throughout it all though they have always played an aggressive, noisy and ambitious style of rock. The band has released material on dozens of record labels including Secretly Canadian, Southern Records and most recently Tizona Records.

title: Other Mathematics
desc_lfm_artist:
Ex Models is an American no wave-influenced post-hardcore band based in Brooklyn, New York.

The band, based around brothers Shahin and Shahryar Motia, was started while they were in high school. They reunited after college to make their first album, Other Mathematics, released in 2001 on Ace Fu Records. The subject of their lyrics ranges from sex to Jean Baudrillard and his philosophy about simulacra.

Their second album, Zoo Psychology, was released two years later.

title: Guerilla Toss
desc_lfm_artist: Guerilla Toss is a band that formed in Boston, Massachusetts, USA in 2012. The band currently consists of  Kassie Carlson (vocals), Arian Shafiee (guitar), Peter Negroponte (drums), Katie McShane (keyboards), and Zach Lewelleyn (bass). Guerilla Toss have released five albums: Gay Disco (2013), Eraser Stargazer (2016), GT Ultra (2017), Twisted Crystal (2018), and Famously Alive (2022).

title: Steal Your Face
desc_lfm_artist:
Formed in August of 2007, the San Francisco trio of Jacob Long (bass), Daniel Martin-McCormick (vocals/guitar) and Damon Palermo (drums) has already issued a handful of limited 12" records on Lover's Rock (their own imprint), White Denim, and Hoss (not to mention a remix they did for Telepathe on Merok) as well as their first full-length "Watersports" and the "Echononecho" single on Quarterstick/Touch & Go in early 2009.

Their Thrill Jockey debut is taking the form of a brand new 12" called "Cut Men" and features two new tracks.
